description: On_Street_Parking_Meters is a dataset listed in City of Gainesville open data portal (data.cityofgainesville.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Gainesville. Parking Operations maintains and collects over 400 parking meters in the downtown area and university context area. This dataset contains the spatial locations and selected attributes of a majority of these parking meters. Coverage: Gainesville, Florida. The portal files it under the category Geospatial (Maps). Its tags are on-street meters, parking meters, parking, metered spaces. The table has 38 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Gainesville Public Works. The portal shows 2020-11-20 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofgainesville-org-portal.
